problem: GNOME Settings reports No Bluetooth Found although the HCI controller and BlueZ are running and powered.

current_before_fix.observation: Read-only snapshot during trial90 recovery; no power, discovery, pairing, loader or service changes.

root_cause.gnome_control_center_branch: cc-bluetooth-panel.c adapter_status_changed_cb selects no-devices-page whenever BluetoothHasAirplaneMode is false, before examining the powered adapter.
root_cause.gnome_settings_daemon_property: gsd-rfkill-manager.c engine_get_has_bluetooth_airplane_mode returns whether bt_killswitches has any entries; these come from /dev/rfkill.
root_cause.linux_hci_registration: net/bluetooth/hci_core.c hci_register_dev already calls rfkill_alloc(... RFKILL_TYPE_BLUETOOTH ...) and rfkill_register; no MT6797-specific rfkill driver is needed.
existing_user_access_rules: 70-uaccess.rules tags miscellaneous rfkill device uaccess for the local desktop user.
root_cause.conclusion: Bluetooth controller startup was integrated, but the standard Linux radio-switch interface required by GNOME was omitted.

changes.packaging_assertion: nix/kernel.nix requires the resolved CONFIG_RFKILL=y rather than accepting a silently dropped symbol.

host_validation.combined_kernel_build_status: Full build and required checks passed; combined image boot integration remains pending.

postboot_observer.required_environment: EXPECTED_BOOT_ID must be the fresh accepted/candidate boot identity.
checks: Character /dev/rfkill exists and the desktop user can read/write it.
HCI0 has a Bluetooth rfkill endpoint with soft and hardware block clear.
Desktop user can read BlueZ Adapter1 and it is powered.
GNOME session BluetoothHasAirplaneMode is true, and BluetoothAirplaneMode, BluetoothHardwareAirplaneMode and AirplaneMode are false.
postboot_observer.side_effects: Read-only; no discovery, power change, pairing or service activation. No nearby device addresses, names or controller UUIDs are retained.
postboot_observer.scope: Checks the exact state inputs used by GNOME50.4; it does not claim pairing/profile or sustained coexistence qualification.
postboot_observer.promotion_gate: Wraps test-boot candidate_return so --keep requires GNOME Bluetooth radio inputs, a synthetic directed/wildcard NM scan and read-only onboard audio mapping. The existing durable supervisor remains the reboot and recovery owner.
